units.chapter: 搜决神鬼章第七十四·附总论之四:星煞值鬼诀
units.chapter_en: Chapter 74, appended general discourse 4: ghosts by the stars and killings
units.title: 总论星煞值鬼诀(一)：看神司先推官鬼（属阳男伤、属阴女鬼），再看临何星何煞；青龙带天喜（正月起戌顺行十二位）是花煞之神；白虎带丧门（正月戌、二月未、三月辰、四月丑循环）是丧煞；朱雀带天火（子卯午酉循环）天烛（正月起巳顺行至辰）是五显灵官、灶神；玄武官爻带天贼（按十二属相）或天盗（亥寅巳申循环）是草野三郎

rule.yi: 看神司，先推官鬼：官鬼属阳，是男人受伤；属阴，是女鬼。再看它临着哪一颗星、哪一个煞，就知道是什么在作祟。青龙上的鬼带天喜，可以说是花煞之神（天喜的排法：正月从戌上起，顺着数十二位）。鬼临白虎又带丧门，就说是丧煞为殃（丧门：正月戌、二月未、三月辰、四月丑、五月又到戌，只在这四个位上循环）。天火、天烛和朱雀同在，是五显灵官和灶皇（天火：正月子、二月卯、三月午、四月酉，循环；天烛：正月起在巳宫，顺着数到辰）；这个煞就是大朱雀，官鬼临上它，就是冒犯了五显灵官、灶神在作祟，而且天烛遇到发动时，做福、祈禳也大凶。玄武上的官爻临着天贼星或天盗煞，就是草野三郎（天贼：正月龙〔辰〕、二月鸡〔酉〕、三月虎〔寅〕、四月羊〔未〕、五月鼠〔子〕、六月蛇〔巳〕、七月犬〔戌〕、八月兔〔卯〕、九月猴〔申〕、十月牛〔丑〕、子月马〔午〕、丑月猪〔亥〕；天盗：正月亥、二月寅、三月巳、四月申，只在这四位上循环）。
rule.en: To look at a god or office, first work out the Pressure line: if it is yang, a man is harmed; if it is yin, it is a woman's ghost. Then look at which star and which killing it sits on, and one knows which haunting is the calamity. A ghost on the Azure Dragon with Heavenly Joy may be called the god of the Flower Killing (Heavenly Joy is set thus: the first month starts from Xu and runs forward through twelve places). A ghost on the White Tiger with Mourning Gate is said to be the Mourning Killing as calamity (Mourning Gate: the first month Xu, the second Wei, the third Chen, the fourth Chou, the fifth again reaching Xu, cycling only through these four positions). Heavenly Fire and Heavenly Candle together with the Vermilion Bird are the Five Manifest Spirit Officials and the Kitchen Sovereign (Heavenly Fire: the first month Zi, the second Mao, the third Wu, the fourth You, cycling; Heavenly Candle: the first month starts at the snake palace and runs forward, counting to the dragon); this killing is the Great Vermilion Bird, and a Pressure line on it is an offence against the Five Manifest Spirit Officials or the Kitchen God as haunting, and when it meets movement, making blessings or praying for exorcism is also very ominous. A Pressure line on the Dark Tortoise that sits on the Heavenly Thief star or the Heavenly Robber killing is the Third Lord of the wilds (Heavenly Thief by the twelve animals: the first month the dragon [Chen], the second the rooster [You], the third the tiger [Yin], the fourth the sheep [Wei], the fifth the rat [Zi], the sixth the snake [Si], the seventh the dog [Xu], the eighth the hare [Mao], the ninth the monkey [Shen], the tenth the ox [Chou], the Zi month the horse [Wu], the Chou month the pig [Hai]; Heavenly Robber: the first month Hai, the second Yin, the third Si, the fourth Shen, cycling only through these four).

yi: 凡是居在卦里，先要论阴阳；
确定是官爻兴动了，要仔细审察；
上面值着青龙、天喜的位置，
一定是花煞有所妨碍。
en: Wherever it sits in the hexagram, discuss yin and yang;
once the Pressure line is fixed as rising, examine it in detail;
if above it holds the Azure Dragon at the Heavenly Joy place,
it is surely the Flower Killing that obstructs.

zh: 正月从戌上顺行十二位也。
yi: 凡是看神司，
必须推官鬼；
属阳就是男人受伤，
属阴就是女鬼；
看它临着哪颗星、哪个煞，
就知道是什么祟在作殃。
鬼值青龙又带天喜，
可以说是花煞之神；
天喜的排法是：
正月从戌上起，顺着数十二位。
en: In looking at a god or office,
one must work out the Pressure line;
if it is yang, a man is harmed;
if it is yin, it is a woman's ghost;
look at which star and which killing it sits on,
and one knows which haunting is the calamity.
A ghost on the Azure Dragon with Heavenly Joy,
may be called the god of the Flower Killing;
the rule for setting Heavenly Joy is:
the first month starts from Xu and runs forward through twelve places.

yi: 如果遇上白虎和丧门照着，
卦里值了这个，就犯丧殃。
en: If it meets the White Tiger shone on by Mourning Gate,
and the hexagram holds this, it offends a mourning calamity.

zh: 正月戌、二月未、三月辰、四月丑、五月又到戌，
yi: 丧门的排法：
正月在戌、二月在未、三月在辰、四月在丑、五月又到戌，
只在这四个位上周而复始。
鬼临白虎和丧门的，
就说是丧煞为殃。
en: The rule for setting Mourning Gate:
the first month Xu, the second Wei, the third Chen, the fourth Chou, the fifth again reaching Xu,
only these four positions, cycling round and round.
A ghost sitting on the White Tiger and Mourning Gate,
one says the Mourning Killing is the calamity.

yi: 天火、天烛和朱雀同在，
是五显灵官和灶皇。
en: Heavenly Fire and Heavenly Candle together with the Vermilion Bird,
are the Five Manifest Spirit Officials and the Kitchen Sovereign.

zh: 正月子、二月卯、三月午、四月酉，
即犯五显灵官、灶神为祟。
yi: 天火的排法：
正月在子、二月在卯、三月在午、四月在酉，
只在这四个位上周而复始。
又有天烛煞说：
天烛正月起在巳宫，
荡荡地顺着数，一直数到龙；
卦里值着它的时候遇上发动，
做福、祈禳也是大凶。
这个煞就是大朱雀，
官鬼如果临在它上面，
就是冒犯了五显灵官、灶神在作祟。
en: The rule for setting Heavenly Fire:
the first month Zi, the second Mao, the third Wu, the fourth You,
only these four positions, cycling round and round.
Again the Heavenly Candle killing says:
the Heavenly Candle starts in the first month at the snake palace,
and runs on forward, counting until it reaches the dragon;
when it is present in the hexagram and meets movement,
making blessings or praying for exorcism is also very ominous.
This killing is the Great Vermilion Bird;
if a Pressure line sits on it,
it is an offence against the Five Manifest Spirit Officials and the Kitchen God as haunting.

yi: 天贼、天盗加在玄武上，
是采山、草野、水三郎。
en: Heavenly Thief and Heavenly Robber added to the Dark Tortoise,
are the Mountain Gatherer, the wilds and the water Third Lord.

zh: 正月亥、二月寅、三月巳、四月申，
玄武官爻临天贼星或临天盗煞，
yi: 天贼星的口诀说：
正月龙、二月鸡、三月是虎的地方，
四月羊、五月鼠、六月蛇藏着，
七月犬、八月兔、九月猴的位，
十月牛、子月马、丑月猪忙碌。
又有天盗煞的排法：
正月在亥、二月在寅、三月在巳、四月在申，
只在这四个位上，
周而复始。
玄武上的官爻临着天贼星或天盗煞，
就是草野三郎。
en: The Heavenly Thief star says:
the first month the dragon, the second the rooster, the third the land of the tiger,
the fourth the sheep, the fifth the rat, the sixth the snake lies hidden,
the seventh the dog, the eighth the hare, the ninth the monkey's place,
the tenth the ox, the Zi month the horse, the Chou month the pig is busy.
Again the rule for setting the Heavenly Robber killing:
the first month Hai, the second Yin, the third Si, the fourth Shen,
only these four positions,
cycling round and round.
A Pressure line on the Dark Tortoise that sits on the Heavenly Thief star or the Heavenly Robber killing
is the Third Lord of the wilds.

dispute.yi: 丧门、天喜怎么排，各书不同。①丧门：易林补遗（LY.ILL.EL.48）是正月戌、二月未、三月辰、四月丑，四个位置周而复始；断易天机的注释引鬼谷子的杀例，同样是正月戌、二月未、三月辰、四月丑，并说「只此四位，轮十二月」；火珠林（卜筮大全里抄了同一段）的丧门杀例是正月未、二月辰、三月丑、四月戌，也说「只此四位轮十二月」——四个位置一样，起点差一位。②天喜：易林补遗是正月从戌起、顺行十二位（戌、亥、子、丑、寅、卯、辰、巳、午、未、申、酉），周易尚占的逐月吉凶神杀表也是这样；卜筮大全的神煞篇是「春戌夏丑为天喜，秋辰冬未」，按季不按月。这几本书都没有说谁对谁错，按哪一家排，同一个月里的位置会不同。
dispute.en: How Mourning Gate and Heavenly Joy are set differs from book to book. (1) Mourning Gate: the Yilin Buyi (LY.ILL.EL.48) has the first month Xu, the second Wei, the third Chen, the fourth Chou, the four positions cycling; the commentary in the Duanyi Tianji quotes the rule of the killings of Guiguzi, which is likewise the first month Xu, the second Wei, the third Chen, the fourth Chou, and says 'only these four positions, rotating through twelve months'; the rule of the Mourning Gate killing in the Huozhulin (whose same passage is copied in the Buyi Daquan) is the first month Wei, the second Chen, the third Chou, the fourth Xu, and also says 'only these four positions rotating through twelve months': the same four positions, with the starting point one place off. (2) Heavenly Joy: the Yilin Buyi has the first month starting from Xu and running forward through twelve places (Xu, Hai, Zi, Chou, Yin, Mao, Chen, Si, Wu, Wei, Shen, You), and the Zhouyi Shangzhan's monthly table of lucky and unlucky stars agrees; the chapter on killings in the Buyi Daquan says 'spring Xu, summer Chou, autumn Chen, winter Wei is Heavenly Joy', by season and not by month. None of these books says which is right, and which one is followed changes the position in the same month.

note.yi: 这是「总论」的第四段（编号「之四」），体例又变了：每条先是一句诗、再是解说，解说里还带着各星煞的「起例」——也就是这颗星每个月落在哪一支。这一节共五条（LY.ILL.EL.48 到 EL.52），讲的是「官鬼临了某颗星、某个煞，就是某位神鬼」，而且要同六兽合看（青龙对天喜，白虎对丧门，朱雀对天火天烛，玄武对天贼天盗……）。这一条的头两句是总则：看神司要先推官鬼，鬼属阳是男人受伤、属阴是女鬼（和黄金策的阳男阴女，LY.ILL.HJC.94 同一路）。「凡居卦下论阴阳」的「卦下」按字面译作「居在卦里」。「灶皇」按字面译作 Kitchen Sovereign，解说里已经说是灶神。「荡荡顺行数至龙」的「龙」是辰，天烛从巳起（蛇宫），数到辰正好十二个月；「采山」在下面 LY.ILL.EL.47 的解说里说就是草野三郎，「水三郎」按字面译。天贼那首口诀把十二属相对着地支读：龙辰、鸡酉、虎寅、羊未、鼠子、蛇巳、犬戌、兔卯、猴申、牛丑、马午、猪亥，每月往后推五位，是一个整齐的数列，易冒也有同一首口诀（易冒讲诸星一章的注），两处一致。 书里没有说这里的「正月、二月」是起卦的月还是别的月，这里照抄；「只此四位周而复始」是说五月回到正月的位置、九月也回到正月的位置，依此类推。 这一段里神、鬼、星煞的名字，是吴地的民间神祇和星煞，书里没有解释，这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: This is the fourth section of the 'general discourse' (numbered 'four'), and its form changes again: each item is a line of verse and then a commentary, and the commentary also carries the 'rules of setting' of each star or killing, that is, the branch on which the star falls in each month. This part of five entries (LY.ILL.EL.48 to EL.52) is about 'a Pressure line on such a star or such a killing is such a god or ghost', and it has to be read together with the six beasts (Azure Dragon with Heavenly Joy, White Tiger with Mourning Gate, Vermilion Bird with Heavenly Fire and Candle, Dark Tortoise with Heavenly Thief and Robber, and so on). The first two lines of this entry are the general rule: to look at a god or office one first works out the Pressure line; a yang ghost is a man harmed and a yin one a woman's ghost (on the same path as the Huangjin Ce's yang is male, yin is female, LY.ILL.HJC.94). 'Everything under the hexagram' in the first verse is translated as 'wherever it sits in the hexagram'. 'Kitchen Sovereign' is a literal rendering of 'zao huang', which the commentary already says is the Kitchen God. In 'counting until it reaches the dragon' the dragon is Chen; the Heavenly Candle starts from Si (the snake palace) and counting to Chen makes exactly twelve months; the 'Mountain Gatherer' is said in the commentary of LY.ILL.EL.47 to be the Third Lord of the wilds, and 'water Third Lord' is rendered literally. The Heavenly Thief verse reads the twelve animals against the branches: dragon Chen, rooster You, tiger Yin, sheep Wei, rat Zi, snake Si, dog Xu, hare Mao, monkey Shen, ox Chou, horse Wu, pig Hai, each month moving on five places, which is a regular series, and the Yi Mao has the same verse (in its note in the chapter on the stars), the two agreeing. The book does not say whether the 'first month' and so on are the months of the divination or of something else, and here it is copied as written; 'only these four positions, cycling round and round' means that the fifth month returns to the position of the first and the ninth to that of the first, and so on. Names of gods, spirits and stars in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; they are cults and stars of the Wu region that the book does not explain, and none is identified here beyond what the book says.

units.title: 总论星煞值鬼诀(二)：勾陈官鬼或螣蛇官鬼临丧门或吊客（正月辰、二月丑、三月戌、四月未循环）皆主伏尸土；玄武鬼爻带咸池沐浴（正月卯、二月子、三月酉、四月午循环）是杜氏夫人；鬼带勾陈又临折煞（正月酉、二月午、三月卯、四月子循环）并卦内驿马（正月申、二月巳、三月寅、四月亥循环）发动必犯途中跌死伤亡；玄武官爻带天河煞（正月起辰顺行十二位）必是井中或江河溺死之鬼

rule.yi: 勾陈上的官鬼或螣蛇上的官鬼，又临着丧门或遇上吊客，都主伏尸土（吊客的排法：正月辰、二月丑、三月戌、四月未，只在这四位上轮；丧门的排法见上一条）。玄武上的鬼爻如果带着咸池、沐浴，就是杜氏夫人（沐浴：正月卯、二月子、三月酉、四月午，只在这四位上轮；咸池煞的排法相同，也是正月卯、二月子、三月酉、四月午）。鬼带勾陈，又临折煞，并且卦里的驿马发动，必定犯了途中跌死、伤亡（折煞：正月酉、二月午、三月卯、四月子，周而复始；驿马：正月申、二月巳、三月寅、四月亥，也是这四位轮）。玄武上的官爻又带天河煞，必是井中溺死的鬼，不然就必是江河里淹死的人（天河煞：正月从辰上起，顺行十二位）。
rule.en: A Hook Earth Pressure line or a Coiling Snake Pressure line that also sits on Mourning Gate or meets Guest of Condolence in every case governs the earth of a buried corpse (Guest of Condolence is set thus: the first month Chen, the second Chou, the third Xu, the fourth Wei, turning only through these four positions; Mourning Gate is set as in the previous entry). If a Dark Tortoise Pressure line carries Xianchi and Bath, it is Lady Du (Bath: the first month Mao, the second Zi, the third You, the fourth Wu, turning only through these four positions; the Xianchi killing is set in the same way, also the first month Mao, the second Zi, the third You, the fourth Wu). If the ghost carries Hook Earth and also sits on Breaking Killing, and the Post Horse in the hexagram moves, it surely offends a death by a fall or an injury on the road (Breaking Killing: the first month You, the second Wu, the third Mao, the fourth Zi, cycling round and round; Post Horse: the first month Shen, the second Si, the third Yin, the fourth Hai, also turning through these four positions). If a Dark Tortoise Pressure line also carries the Heavenly River killing, it is surely the ghost of one drowned in a well, or else of one drowned in a river (Heavenly River killing: the first month starts from Chen and runs forward through twelve places).

yi: 丧门、吊客在勾陈、螣蛇的位置上，
伏尸、土禁，都不是好事。
en: Mourning Gate and Guest of Condolence at the seats of Hook Earth and the Coiling Snake,
the buried corpse and the earth taboos are not good.

zh: 正月辰、二月丑、三月戌、四月未，
yi: 丧门已经写在篇首，
吊客的排法：
正月在辰、二月在丑、三月在戌、四月在未，
只在这四个位上轮转。
勾陈上的官鬼，或是螣蛇上的官鬼，
又临着丧门，或者遇上吊客，
都主伏尸土。
en: Mourning Gate has been set out at the head of the chapter;
the rule for setting Guest of Condolence:
the first month Chen, the second Chou, the third Xu, the fourth Wei,
only these four positions turn in rotation.
A Hook Earth Pressure line, or a Coiling Snake Pressure line,
that also sits on Mourning Gate or meets Guest of Condolence,
in every case governs the earth of a buried corpse.

yi: 沐浴、咸池遇上玄武发动，
杜氏夫人发出祸殃。
en: Bath and Xianchi with the Dark Tortoise moving,
Lady Du sets off misfortune.

zh: 正月卯、二月子、三月酉、四月午，
正月卯、二月子、三月酉、四月午，
玄武鬼爻如带咸池沐浴，
yi: 沐浴的排法：
正月在卯、二月在子、三月在酉、四月在午，
只在这四个位上轮转；
咸池煞是这样排的：
正月在卯、二月在子、三月在酉、四月在午，
也是这四个位上轮转。
玄武上的鬼爻如果带着咸池、沐浴，
就是杜氏夫人。
en: The rule for setting Bath:
the first month Mao, the second Zi, the third You, the fourth Wu,
only these four positions in rotation;
the Xianchi killing:
the first month Mao, the second Zi, the third You, the fourth Wu,
these four positions also in rotation.
If a Dark Tortoise Pressure line carries Xianchi and Bath,
it is Lady Du.

yi: 折煞、勾陈再加上驿马，
街上的妨碍、跌死、横死伤亡。
en: Breaking Killing and Hook Earth with the Post Horse added,
obstruction in the street, death by a fall, violent injury and death.

zh: 正月酉、二月午、三月卯、四月子只此四位周而复始。
正月申、二月巳、三月寅、四月亥，
鬼带勾陈又临折煞、并卦内驿马发动，
yi: 折煞的排法：
正月在酉、二月在午、三月在卯、四月在子，只在这四个位上周而复始。
又有驿马的排法：
正月在申、二月在巳、三月在寅、四月在亥，
也是这四个位上轮转。
鬼带勾陈，又临折煞，并且卦里的驿马发动，
必定犯了途中跌死、伤亡。
en: The rule for setting Breaking Killing:
the first month You, the second Wu, the third Mao, the fourth Zi, only these four positions, cycling round and round.
Again the rule for setting the Post Horse:
the first month Shen, the second Si, the third Yin, the fourth Hai,
these four positions also in rotation.
If the ghost carries Hook Earth and also sits on Breaking Killing, and the Post Horse in the hexagram moves,
it surely offends a death by a fall or an injury on the road.

yi: 官鬼临着玄武，又带天河煞，
井中溺死的鬼作出灾殃。
en: The Pressure line on the Dark Tortoise, with the Heavenly River killing,
the ghost drowned in a well makes calamity.

zh: 玄武官爻又带天河煞者，
yi: 天河煞的排法：
正月从辰上起，
顺着行十二位。
玄武上的官爻又带着天河煞的，
必定是井中溺死的鬼，
不然必定是江河里淹死的人。
en: The rule for setting the Heavenly River killing:
the first month starts from Chen,
and runs forward through twelve places.
A Dark Tortoise Pressure line that also carries the Heavenly River killing
is surely the ghost of one drowned in a well,
or else surely of one drowned in a river.

note.yi: 这一条讲勾陈、螣蛇、玄武三兽各自配的星煞。伏尸土：「陈蛇位」是勾陈、螣蛇这两个土兽的位置；「伏尸土禁」按字面译作「buried corpse and the earth taboos」——「土禁」可能指动土的禁忌，书里没有解释。「街妨」译作「obstruction in the street」。沐浴、咸池在书里是两个星，排法却一样（正月卯、二月子、三月酉、四月午），都是每次往后退三位的四位循环。「瀹死」的「瀹」本义是煮，这里按上下句（「溺死」）读作溺死。折煞、驿马也各有四位循环（折煞每次退三位，驿马每次退三位）。天河煞和官符、刀砧一样，是从正月起顺行十二个月，一个月一位。和易冒「天河为觉溺之屈」（LY.ILL.YM.62）、易隐「风波浴盆浮沉溺死」（LY.ILL.YY.29）是同一件事。 书里没有说这里的「正月、二月」是起卦的月还是别的月，这里照抄；「只此四位周而复始」是说五月回到正月的位置、九月也回到正月的位置，依此类推。 这一段里神、鬼、星煞的名字，是吴地的民间神祇和星煞，书里没有解释，这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: This entry is about the stars and killings matched with each of the three beasts Hook Earth, the Coiling Snake and the Dark Tortoise. The earth of a buried corpse: the 'seats of Hook Earth and the Coiling Snake' are the positions of these two Earth beasts; 'the buried corpse and the earth taboos' is translated literally, and the 'earth taboos' may mean the taboos on digging the earth, which the book does not explain. 'Jie fang' is translated as 'obstruction in the street'. Bath and Xianchi are two different stars in this book but are set the same way (the first month Mao, the second Zi, the third You, the fourth Wu), a cycle of four positions each moving back three places. The 'yue' in 'yue si' properly means to boil, and is read here as drowned from the neighbouring line ('drowned'). Breaking Killing and the Post Horse also each have a cycle of four positions (Breaking Killing moving back three places at each step, and the Post Horse likewise). The Heavenly River killing, like the Official Talisman and the Chopping Block, runs forward from the first month through the twelve months, one place a month. It is the same matter as the Yi Mao's 'Heavenly River is the wrong of those who wake to drown' (LY.ILL.YM.62) and the Yi Yin's 'wind and waves, the Bath Basin, floating and sinking, drowned' (LY.ILL.YY.29). The book does not say whether the 'first month' and so on are the months of the divination or of something else, and here it is copied as written; 'only these four positions, cycling round and round' means that the fifth month returns to the position of the first and the ninth to that of the first, and so on. Names of gods, spirits and stars in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; they are cults and stars of the Wu region that the book does not explain, and none is identified here beyond what the book says.

units.chapter: 搜决神鬼章第七十四·附总论之四:星煞值鬼诀
units.chapter_en: Chapter 74, appended general discourse 4: ghosts by the stars and killings
units.title: 总论星煞值鬼诀(三)：朱雀官鬼值官符（正月从午顺行十二位）是总管作祟；鬼带刀砧（正月从午顺行十二位）或逢羊刃（甲卯乙辰丙戊午丁己未庚酉辛戌壬子癸丑）是伤司；鬼值太岁带黄旌（正月戌、二月未、三月辰、四月丑循环）是后土（土皇）；官临贵人（甲戊庚牛羊、乙己鼠猴、丙丁猪鸡、壬癸蛇兔、六辛马虎）或天喜是萧堂五圣

rule.yi: 朱雀上的官鬼又值着官符，就说是总管在作祟（官符：正月从午上起，顺行十二位）。鬼带刀砧，或遇上羊刃，就是伤司（刀砧煞：正月从午上起，顺行十二位；羊刃煞按日干：甲日在卯、乙日在辰、丙戊日在午、丁己日在未、庚日在酉、辛日在戌、壬日在子、癸日在丑）。太岁就是当年；鬼值太岁若带着黄旌，就是后土，后土就是土皇（黄旌星：正月戌、二月未、三月辰、四月丑，只在这四位上轮）。官鬼临着贵人或者天喜，就是萧堂五圣（天乙贵人：甲、戊、庚日在牛羊〔丑未〕，乙、己日在鼠猴〔子申〕，丙、丁日在猪鸡〔亥酉〕，壬、癸日在蛇兔〔巳卯〕，辛日遇马虎〔午寅〕；天喜的排法见前）。
rule.en: A Pressure line on the Vermilion Bird that also meets the Official Talisman is said to be the Chief Official haunting (Official Talisman: the first month starts from Wu and runs forward through twelve places). A ghost carrying the Chopping Block, or meeting the Goat Blade, is the Injuring Office (Chopping Block killing: the first month starts from Wu and runs forward through twelve places; Goat Blade killing by day stem: a Jia day at Mao, a Yi day at Chen, a Bing or Wu day at Wu, a Ding or Ji day at Wei, a Geng day at You, a Xin day at Xu, a Ren day at Zi, a Gui day at Chou). Tai Sui is the year itself; a ghost on Tai Sui, if it carries the Yellow Banner, is then the Sovereign Earth, and the Sovereign Earth is the Earth Emperor (Yellow Banner star: the first month Xu, the second Wei, the third Chen, the fourth Chou, turning only through these four). A Pressure line on the Noble or on Heavenly Joy is the Five Sages of the Xiao Hall (Tianyi Noble: Jia, Wu and Geng days at the ox and sheep [Chou, Wei], Yi and Ji days at the rat and monkey [Zi, Shen], Bing and Ding days at the pig and rooster [Hai, You], Ren and Gui days at the snake and hare [Si, Mao], and Xin days meeting the horse and tiger [Wu, Yin]; Heavenly Joy is set as before).

yi: 朱雀遇上官符，就是总管；
刀砧、羊刃，是西伤。
en: The Vermilion Bird with the Official Talisman is the Chief Official;
the Chopping Block and the Goat Blade are the Western Injury.

zh: 官符起例：正月从午上起，顺行十二位。
又刀砧煞起例；正月从午上起，顺行十二位。
甲日在卯，乙日在辰，丙戊日在午，丁己日在未，庚日在酉，辛日在戌，壬日在子，癸日在丑，
鬼临朱雀更值官符，便言总管作祟，
鬼带刀砧或逢羊刃，即是伤司。
yi: 官符的排法：正月从午上起，顺着行十二位。
又有刀砧煞的排法：正月从午上起，顺着行十二位。
羊刃煞的排法：
甲日在卯，乙日在辰，丙、戊日在午，丁、己日在未，庚日在酉，辛日在戌，壬日在子，癸日在丑，
鬼临着朱雀又值官符，就说是总管在作祟；
鬼带刀砧，或者遇上羊刃，就是伤司。
en: The rule for setting the Official Talisman: the first month starts from Wu and runs forward through twelve places.
Again the rule for setting the Chopping Block killing: the first month starts from Wu and runs forward through twelve places.
The rule for setting the Goat Blade killing:
a Jia day at Mao, a Yi day at Chen, a Bing or Wu day at Wu, a Ding or Ji day at Wei, a Geng day at You, a Xin day at Xu, a Ren day at Zi, a Gui day at Chou;
a ghost on the Vermilion Bird that also meets the Official Talisman, one says the Chief Official is haunting;
a ghost carrying the Chopping Block or meeting the Goat Blade is the Injuring Office.

yi: 太岁、黄旌，要向后土祈祷；
贵人、天喜，要向萧堂酬谢。
en: Tai Sui and the Yellow Banner: pray to the Sovereign Earth;
the Noble and Heavenly Joy: give thanks to the Xiao Hall.

zh: 黄旌星起例：正月戌、二月未、三月辰、四月丑，只此四位轮。
甲戊庚牛羊，乙己鼠猴乡，
丙丁猪鸡位，壬癸蛇兔藏，
六辛逢马虎，此是贵人方。
鬼值太岁若带黄旌，即为后土。
又论官临贵人或临天喜，便是萧堂五圣。
yi: 太岁，就是当年。
黄旌星的排法：正月戌、二月未、三月辰、四月丑，只在这四位上轮。
又有天乙贵人的口诀说：
甲、戊、庚日是牛羊（丑未），乙、己日是鼠猴的地方（子申），
丙、丁日是猪鸡的位（亥酉），壬、癸日蛇兔藏着（巳卯），
六个辛日遇马、虎（午寅），这些是贵人的方位。
天喜星已经列在篇前，
鬼值太岁，如果带着黄旌，就是后土。
后土，就是土皇。
又论官鬼临着贵人，或者临着天喜，就是萧堂五圣。
en: Tai Sui is the year itself.
The rule for setting the Yellow Banner star: the first month Xu, the second Wei, the third Chen, the fourth Chou, only these four positions in rotation.
Again the Tianyi Noble says:
Jia, Wu and Geng days: the ox and sheep; Yi and Ji days: the land of the rat and monkey;
Bing and Ding days: the places of the pig and rooster; Ren and Gui days: the snake and hare lie hidden;
the six Xin days meet the horse and tiger; these are the directions of the Noble.
The Heavenly Joy star has already been set out earlier;
a ghost on Tai Sui, if it carries the Yellow Banner, is then the Sovereign Earth.
The Sovereign Earth is the Earth Emperor.
Again, a Pressure line sitting on the Noble or on Heavenly Joy is the Five Sages of the Xiao Hall.

dispute.yi: 天乙贵人和羊刃怎么定，各书不同。①天乙贵人：易林补遗（LY.ILL.EL.50）是「甲戊庚牛羊，乙己鼠猴乡，丙丁猪鸡位，壬癸蛇兔藏，六辛逢马虎」，庚日的贵人在牛羊（丑未）；卜筮大全的神煞篇是「甲戊兼牛羊，乙己鼠猴乡，丙丁猪鸡位，壬癸兔蛇藏，庚辛逢马虎」，庚日和辛日一样在马虎（午寅）；周易尚占的逐日表里庚日的贵人也是午。②羊刃：易林补遗是每个日干都取「禄前一位」（甲卯、乙辰、丙戊午、丁己未、庚酉、辛戌、壬子、癸丑）；易冒讲诸星一章的注明说阳干顺行、阴干逆行（甲禄寅取卯、乙禄卯取寅、丙戊禄巳取午、丁己禄午取巳，「乙逢寅动当为刃，辛见申摇岂不凶，丁己忌巳癸忧亥」），并批评「近世不分阴阳顺逆，概以禄前一位为刃，至有误认乙禄到卯、辰为羊刃之说」——易林补遗的表正是这种一律取禄前一位的排法（乙日在辰），易冒没有点名。两边差在乙、丁、己、辛、癸五个阴干上，书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: How the Tianyi Noble and the Goat Blade are fixed differs from book to book. (1) Tianyi Noble: the Yilin Buyi (LY.ILL.EL.50) has 'Jia, Wu and Geng the ox and sheep; Yi and Ji the land of the rat and monkey; Bing and Ding the places of the pig and rooster; Ren and Gui the snake and hare lie hidden; the six Xin meet the horse and tiger', so that the Noble of a Geng day is at the ox and sheep (Chou, Wei); the chapter on killings in the Buyi Daquan has 'Jia and Wu together the ox and sheep; Yi and Ji the land of the rat and monkey; Bing and Ding the places of the pig and rooster; Ren and Gui the hare and snake lie hidden; Geng and Xin meet the horse and tiger', so that a Geng day is, like a Xin day, at the horse and tiger (Wu, Yin); in the table by day in the Zhouyi Shangzhan the Noble of a Geng day is also Wu. (2) Goat Blade: the Yilin Buyi takes, for every day stem, 'the place one step ahead of the Salary' (Jia Mao, Yi Chen, Bing and Wu Wu, Ding and Ji Wei, Geng You, Xin Xu, Ren Zi, Gui Chou); the note of the Yi Mao in its chapter on the stars says plainly that yang stems go forward and yin stems go backward (Jia with its Salary at Yin takes Mao, Yi with its Salary at Mao takes Yin, Bing and Wu with the Salary at Si take Wu, Ding and Ji with the Salary at Wu take Si, 'Yi meeting Yin moving is surely the blade, Xin seeing Shen shake is not ominous, Ding and Ji fear Si and Gui worries about Hai'), and it criticises that 'in recent times people do not tell yang from yin, forward from backward, and take in every case the place one step ahead of the Salary as the blade, even to the mistaken saying that Yi with its Salary at Mao has Chen as the Goat Blade': the Yilin Buyi's table is exactly this way of taking the place one step ahead of the Salary in every case (Yi on Chen), though the Yi Mao does not name it. The two differ on the five yin stems Yi, Ding, Ji, Xin and Gui, and the books do not settle it.

note.yi: 这一条讲朱雀、白虎（伤司）、太岁、贵人配的星煞。官符和刀砧煞的排法完全一样：正月从午起，顺行十二个月，一月一位；羊刃煞不按月、按日干排，一个日干一个位置。「太岁者，即年如也」的「如」文字费解，按「太岁就是当年」译。天乙贵人那首口诀里的牛羊是丑未、鼠猴是子申、猪鸡是亥酉、蛇兔是巳卯、马虎是午寅，译文里一并写出地支。「六辛」按字面译作「the six Xin days」（辛日）。「后土者，土皇也」——后土（Sovereign Earth）就是土皇（Earth Emperor），和前面的勾陈、土鬼里的「土皇」（LY.ILL.EL.34、EL.47）是同一个称呼。「萧堂五圣」按字面译作 the Five Sages of the Xiao Hall，和前面的「萧公即五圣」（LY.ILL.EL.46）呼应。这里「贵人」的「贵人」不是天将，是天乙贵人星。 书里没有说这里的「正月、二月」是起卦的月还是别的月，这里照抄；「只此四位周而复始」是说五月回到正月的位置、九月也回到正月的位置，依此类推。 这一段里神、鬼、星煞的名字，是吴地的民间神祇和星煞，书里没有解释，这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: This entry is about the stars and killings matched with the Vermilion Bird, the White Tiger (the Injuring Office), Tai Sui and the Noble. The Official Talisman and the Chopping Block killing are set in exactly the same way: from Wu in the first month, running forward through the twelve months, one place a month; the Goat Blade killing is set not by month but by day stem, one position for each day stem. The 'ru' in 'Tai Sui is the year itself' is hard to understand, and is translated as 'Tai Sui is the year itself'. In the verse of the Tianyi Noble the ox and sheep are Chou and Wei, the rat and monkey Zi and Shen, the pig and rooster Hai and You, the snake and hare Si and Mao, and the horse and tiger Wu and Yin, and the translation writes the branches out together. 'The six Xin' is translated literally as 'the six Xin days' (Xin days). 'The Sovereign Earth is the Earth Emperor': the Sovereign Earth is the Earth Emperor, the same title as 'Earth Emperor' in the earlier Hook Earth and Earth ghost entries (LY.ILL.EL.34, EL.47). 'The Five Sages of the Xiao Hall' is a literal rendering, and echoes the earlier 'Lord Xiao is the Five Sages' (LY.ILL.EL.46). The 'Noble' here is not a celestial general but the Tianyi Noble star. The book does not say whether the 'first month' and so on are the months of the divination or of something else, and here it is copied as written; 'only these four positions, cycling round and round' means that the fifth month returns to the position of the first and the ninth to that of the first, and so on. Names of gods, spirits and stars in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; they are cults and stars of the Wu region that the book does not explain, and none is identified here beyond what the book says.

units.chapter: 搜决神鬼章第七十四·附总论之四:星煞值鬼诀
units.chapter_en: Chapter 74, appended general discourse 4: ghosts by the stars and killings
units.title: 总论星煞值鬼诀(四)：鬼值三丘（春丑夏辰秋未冬戌）或临五墓（对宫取，春未夏戌秋丑冬辰）便为坟墓；土鬼带暗金煞（寅申巳亥在巳、子午卯酉在酉、辰戌丑未在丑）或值羊刃是产亡带血之鬼；冲对年庚为撞命（天对甲庚乙辛丙壬丁癸、地冲六冲；天对且地冲是真撞命，只地冲是傍撞命，只天对不冲不是）；鬼值年建当言太岁

rule.yi: 鬼值三丘，或者临着五墓，就是坟墓（三丘：春丑、夏辰、秋未、三冬逢戌；五墓从三丘的对宫取，病人做福也难留）。土鬼带着暗金煞，或者值着羊刃星，是难产而亡、带血的鬼（暗金煞：寅、申、巳、亥的落在巳，子、午、卯、酉的落在酉，辰、戌、丑、未的落在丑；暗金对产妇最难当）。冲到病人的生年（年庚）就叫撞命：撞有天对和地冲的分别，天对是甲庚、乙辛、丙壬、丁癸，地冲是子午、丑未、寅申、卯酉、辰戌、巳亥；天对又地冲是真撞命（比如病人丙子年生，卦里壬午鬼动），只有地冲而天干大不对的（比如庚午鬼）是傍撞命，只有天对而地不冲的不算撞命；鬼值年建，就说是太岁。
rule.en: A ghost on the Three Mounds, or on the Five Tombs, is then a grave (Three Mounds: spring Chou, summer Chen, autumn Wei, the three winter months meeting Xu; the Five Tombs are taken from the opposite palace of the Three Mounds, so that even when the sick person performs blessing rites he can hardly be kept). An Earth ghost carrying the Hidden Metal killing, or sitting on the Goat Blade star, is the bloody ghost of one who died in childbirth (Hidden Metal killing: for Yin, Shen, Si and Hai it falls at Si; for Zi, Wu, Mao and You at You; for Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei at Chou; Hidden Metal is the hardest for a woman in childbirth to bear). A clash on the year of birth (nian geng) of the sick person is called a collision with life: collision has the distinction of heaven-opposition and earth-clash; heaven-opposition is Jia-Geng, Yi-Xin, Bing-Ren and Ding-Gui, and earth-clash is Zi-Wu, Chou-Wei, Yin-Shen, Mao-You, Chen-Xu and Si-Hai; heaven-opposition together with earth-clash is a true collision with life (for example, the sick person was born in the Bingzi year and a Renwu ghost moves in the hexagram); earth-clash with the stems greatly unmatched (for example a Gengwu ghost) is a side collision with life; heaven-opposition without earth-clash is not a collision with life; if the ghost sits on the year's branch, one says it is on Tai Sui.

yi: 三丘、五墓，是坟前的土；
暗金、羊刃，是产中亡故的。
en: Three Mounds and Five Tombs: the earth before a grave;
Hidden Metal and Goat Blade: death in childbirth.

zh: 春丑，夏辰，秋即未，三冬逢戍是三丘。
却兴五墓对宫取，病人作福也难留。
寅申巳亥巳来防，子午卯酉酉相妨，
辰戌丑未丑位是，暗金产妇最难当，
鬼值三丘或临五墓，便为坟墓。
土鬼带暗金煞或值羊刃星，层口是产亡带血之鬼也。
yi: 三丘、五墓煞的口诀说：
春丑，夏辰，秋是未，三冬遇到戌，这是三丘。
再兴五墓，是从对宫取的，病人做福也难留。
又有暗金煞的口诀说：
寅、申、巳、亥，巳来防备；子、午、卯、酉，酉相妨害；
辰、戌、丑、未，是丑位；暗金对产妇最难当，
羊刃已经写在前面了。
鬼值三丘，或者临着五墓，就是坟墓。
土鬼带着暗金煞，或者值着羊刃星，（此处原文含混）是产亡带血的鬼。
en: The Three Mounds and Five Tombs killings say:
spring Chou, summer Chen, autumn Wei, the three winter months meet Xu: these are the Three Mounds.
Then the Five Tombs are taken from the opposite palace; even if the sick person performs blessing rites, he can hardly be kept.
Again the Hidden Metal killing says:
for Yin, Shen, Si and Hai, guard against Si; for Zi, Wu, Mao and You, You obstructs;
for Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei, it is the Chou place; Hidden Metal is the hardest for a woman in childbirth to bear;
the Goat Blade has already been set out earlier.
A ghost on the Three Mounds or on the Five Tombs is then a grave.
An Earth ghost carrying the Hidden Metal killing, or sitting on the Goat Blade star, (the text is garbled here) is the bloody ghost of one who died in childbirth.

yi: 冲对到年庚，就叫撞命；
流年遇上鬼，岁君当值。
en: A clash or opposition to the year of birth is called a collision with life;
in the current year, meeting the ghost, Tai Sui (the Year Lord) is in charge.

zh: 撞对者，有天对地冲之辨。
天对者，甲庚、乙辛、丙壬、丁癸是也。
地冲者，子午、丑未、寅申、卯酉、辰戌、巳亥是也。
假如病人丙子生，卦中壬午鬼动，正所谓天对地冲，此乃真撞命上也。
又如庚午鬼地冲大不对，乃傍撞命上也，余偕仿此。
设若天对地不冲，非是撞命之沦。
如鬼值年建，当言太岁上也。
yi: 撞对，有天对和地冲的分别。
天对，是甲庚、乙辛、丙壬、丁癸。
地冲，是子午、丑未、寅申、卯酉、辰戌、巳亥。
假如病人是丙子年生，卦里壬午鬼发动，正是所说的天对地冲，这是真撞命。
又如庚午鬼，地冲而天干大不对，是傍撞命，其余都照这样仿。
假设天对而地不冲，不算是撞命。
如果鬼值年建，就应当说在太岁上。
en: A collision-opposition has the distinction of heaven-opposition and earth-clash.
Heaven-opposition is Jia-Geng, Yi-Xin, Bing-Ren and Ding-Gui.
Earth-clash is Zi-Wu, Chou-Wei, Yin-Shen, Mao-You, Chen-Xu and Si-Hai.
Suppose the sick person was born in the Bingzi year and in the hexagram the Renwu ghost moves: this is exactly what is called heaven-opposition with earth-clash, a true collision with life.
Or again, a Gengwu ghost, an earth-clash but greatly unmatched in the stems, is a side collision with life; the rest all follow this.
Suppose there is heaven-opposition but no earth-clash: it is not a case of falling into collision with life.
If the ghost sits on the year's branch, one should say it is on Tai Sui.

note.yi: 三丘、五墓的口诀，卜筮大全的神煞篇里有一模一样的一首（「春丑夏辰秋即未，三冬逢戌是三丘；却与五墓对宫取，病人作福也难留」），断易天机的注释引鬼谷子的五墓杀例是「春未、夏戌、秋丑、冬辰」，正是三丘的对宫，三处一致；周易尚占的四时神杀表也是三丘春丑夏辰秋未冬戌、五墓春未夏戌秋丑冬辰。原文「三冬逢戍」的「戍」是「戌」的误刻，按戌译。暗金煞的口诀没有说前面的寅申巳亥是什么的支（日、月还是年），原文只写「寅申巳亥巳来防」，这里照抄、不补；「羊刃已其在前」按「羊刃已经写在前面」译；「层口是产亡带血之鬼也」的「层口」文字含混，这里译出后面的意思，并在译文里标明这里原文含混。撞命这一段：「年庚」是生年干支，「撞对」是冲或对着它；天对是天干相冲（甲庚、乙辛、丙壬、丁癸），地冲是地支相冲；例子里病人丙子年生、鬼是壬午——壬对丙是天对、午冲子是地冲，两样都有，所以是真撞命；庚午鬼和丙子只有午冲子（庚不对丙），所以是傍撞命；只有天干相对、地支不冲的，不算撞命。「鬼值年建当言太岁」是说鬼落在当年地支上，就当太岁论（不再按撞命论）。与黄金策「太岁鬼临是祖传旧例」（LY.ILL.HJC.109）是同一个落点。 这一段里神、鬼、星煞的名字，是吴地的民间神祇和星煞，书里没有解释，这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: The verse of the Three Mounds and Five Tombs is found word for word in the chapter on killings of the Buyi Daquan ('spring Chou, summer Chen, autumn Wei, the three winter months meet Xu are the Three Mounds; then the Five Tombs are taken from the opposite palace, and even if the sick person performs blessing rites he can hardly be kept'); the commentary in the Duanyi Tianji quotes the rule of the Five Tombs killing from Guiguzi as 'spring Wei, summer Xu, autumn Chou, winter Chen', which is exactly the opposite palace of the Three Mounds, so the three agree; the Zhouyi Shangzhan's table of seasonal killings also has the Three Mounds at spring Chou, summer Chen, autumn Wei, winter Xu and the Five Tombs at spring Wei, summer Xu, autumn Chou, winter Chen. The 'xu' in the original 'the three winter months meet Xu' is a miscut of 'xu' (the branch Xu), and is translated as Xu. The verse of the Hidden Metal killing does not say what branch the preceding Yin, Shen, Si and Hai are (of the day, the month or the year), the original only writing 'for Yin, Shen, Si, Hai, guard against Si', and it is copied as written and not supplied; 'the Goat Blade has already been set out' translates a garbled 'yang ren yi qi zai qian'; the 'ceng kou' in 'ceng kou is the bloody ghost of one who died in childbirth' is garbled, and the meaning of what follows is given and the translation marks that the original is garbled here. The collision with life: 'nian geng' is the stem-branch of the birth year, and 'zhuang dui' is a clash with or opposition to it; heaven-opposition is a clash of stems (Jia-Geng, Yi-Xin, Bing-Ren, Ding-Gui) and earth-clash a clash of branches; in the example the sick person was born in the Bingzi year and the ghost is Renwu: Ren opposes Bing (heaven-opposition) and Wu clashes Zi (earth-clash), so both are present and it is a true collision; the Gengwu ghost and Bingzi have only Wu clashing Zi (Geng does not oppose Bing), so it is a side collision; where the stems are opposed but the branches do not clash, it does not count as a collision. 'A ghost on the year's branch is to be called Tai Sui' means that a ghost falling on the branch of the current year is judged as Tai Sui (and no longer as a collision with life). It comes to the same point as the Huangjin Ce's 'the ghost on Tai Sui is an old family custom' (LY.ILL.HJC.109). Names of gods, spirits and stars in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; they are cults and stars of the Wu region that the book does not explain, and none is identified here beyond what the book says.

units.chapter: 搜决神鬼章第七十四·附总论之四:星煞值鬼诀
units.chapter_en: Chapter 74, appended general discourse 4: ghosts by the stars and killings
units.title: 总论星煞值鬼诀(五)：官临华盖（正月戌、二月未、三月辰、四月丑循环）是僧道之魂，鬼值咸池是邪淫之鬼；鬼值天刑（正月起辰逆行十二位）必犯责死之鬼，临天狱煞（正月亥、二月申、三月龙蛇、四月寅循环）是牢中之鬼，临劫煞（与天狱同）或刀砧必自刎而亡

rule.yi: 官鬼临着华盖，就是僧道的魂（华盖：正月戌、二月未、三月辰、四月丑，只在这四位上周而复始；咸池煞已写在前面）。鬼值咸池，就是邪淫的鬼。鬼值天刑煞，必定是犯了被责打死的鬼（天刑：正月从辰上起，逆行十二位）；如果临着天狱煞，就是牢里的鬼（天狱煞：正月遇亥，二月申，三月龙蛇〔即巳〕，四月寅，五月循环又到亥，周而复始定它是哪一路神）；鬼临劫煞，或者刀砧煞，必定是自刎而亡的（劫煞的起法和天狱煞相同，刀砧煞见前）。
rule.en: A Pressure line sitting on Huagai is the soul of a monk or Daoist (Huagai: the first month Xu, the second Wei, the third Chen, the fourth Chou, cycling round and round through only these four positions; the Xianchi killing has been set out earlier). A ghost on Xianchi is a ghost of lewdness. A ghost on the Heavenly Punishment killing is surely one who offended by dying of flogging (Heavenly Punishment: the first month starts from Chen and runs backward through twelve places); if it sits on the Heavenly Prison killing, it is a ghost in prison (Heavenly Prison killing: the first month meets Hai, the second Shen, the third the dragon or snake [that is, Si], the fourth Yin, the fifth month circles round and reaches Hai again, cycling round and round it fixes which spirit it is); a ghost on the Robbery Killing or the Chopping Block killing is surely one who died by cutting his own throat (the Robbery Killing is set in the same way as the Heavenly Prison killing, the Chopping Block killing as before).

yi: 华盖，是僧人的魂和道士；
咸池，是妓女和邪淫的女子。
en: Huagai: the souls of monks and Daoists;
Xianchi: courtesans and depraved women.

zh: 正月戌、二月未、三月辰、四月丑，
官临华盖乃为僧道之魂。
yi: 华盖的排法：
正月在戌、二月在未、三月在辰、四月在丑，
只在这四个位上，
周而复始。
咸池煞已经写在前面，
官鬼临着华盖，就是僧道的魂。
鬼值咸池，
就是邪淫的鬼。
en: The rule for setting Huagai:
the first month Xu, the second Wei, the third Chen, the fourth Chou,
only these four positions,
cycling round and round.
The Xianchi killing was set out earlier;
the Pressure line on Huagai is the soul of a monk or Daoist.
A ghost on Xianchi
is a ghost of lewdness.

yi: 天刑，是牢狱中的鬼。
劫煞、刀砧，是自刎受伤的。
en: Heavenly Punishment: the ghost in the prison.
Robbery Killing and the Chopping Block: wounded by cutting one's own throat.

yi: 天刑的排法：
正月从辰上起，
倒着行十二位。
天狱煞的口诀说：
正月遇到亥、二月遇到申，
三月龙蛇、四月寅，
五月循环又到亥，
周而复始，定它是哪一路神。
劫煞的起法和天狱煞相同。
刀砧煞也已经写在前面：
鬼值天刑煞，
必定犯了被责打死的鬼；
如果临着天狱煞，
就是牢中的鬼；
鬼临着劫煞，或者刀砧煞，
必定是自刎而亡的。
en: The rule for setting Heavenly Punishment:
the first month starts from Chen,
and runs backward through twelve places.
The Heavenly Prison killing says:
the first month meets Hai, the second Shen,
the third the dragon or snake, the fourth Yin,
the fifth month circles round and reaches Hai again,
cycling round and round it fixes which spirit it is.
The Robbery Killing rises the same as the Heavenly Prison killing.
The Chopping Block killing has also been set out earlier:
a ghost on the Heavenly Punishment killing
is surely one who offended by dying of flogging;
if it sits on the Heavenly Prison killing,
it is a ghost in prison;
a ghost on the Robbery Killing or the Chopping Block killing
is surely one who died by cutting his own throat.

note.yi: 华盖是每次退三位的四位循环（戌、未、辰、丑），咸池已在 LY.ILL.EL.49 写了。天刑是从正月的辰起、每月退一位，走十二个月（和官符、刀砧、天河相反的方向）；断易天机的注释引鬼谷子的刑煞例（天刑）也是「从正月起辰，逆行」，一致。天狱煞「三月龙蛇」：龙是辰、蛇是巳，原文没有定是哪一个；按前后是每次退三位（亥、申、巳、寅），这里应是巳，易冒讲诸星一章注里引的同一首口诀写的是「三月随蛇」，是巳，所以译文里写作「the dragon or snake」并在这里说明。「劫煞兴天狱煞同」按字面译，不另作展开；歌诀「天刑牢狱中鬼」少了一个字（应是「天刑天狱牢中鬼」），这里按残句直译，「自刎伤」译作「wounded by cutting one's own throat」。「责死」是被责打（杖责）而死。与易隐「鬼带天刑天狱牢狱鬼」「鬼加刀砧羊刃劫杀自刎鬼」「鬼带华盖孤神僧道绝嗣鬼」（LY.ILL.YY.29）、易冒「天狱笞杖徒流之鬼」「华盖僧道咸池娼妓」（LY.ILL.YM.62）同一路。 书里没有说这里的「正月、二月」是起卦的月还是别的月，这里照抄；「只此四位周而复始」是说五月回到正月的位置、九月也回到正月的位置，依此类推。 这一段里神、鬼、星煞的名字，是吴地的民间神祇和星煞，书里没有解释，这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: Huagai is a cycle of four positions each moving back three places (Xu, Wei, Chen, Chou), and Xianchi was already written in LY.ILL.EL.49. Heavenly Punishment starts from Chen in the first month and moves back one place a month through the twelve months (the opposite direction to the Official Talisman, the Chopping Block and the Heavenly River); the commentary in the Duanyi Tianji quotes the rule of Guiguzi for the punishing killing (Heavenly Punishment) as 'starting from Chen in the first month and running backward', which agrees. In the Heavenly Prison killing's 'the third month the dragon or snake', the dragon is Chen and the snake is Si, and the original does not fix which; the series moves back three places each time (Hai, Shen, Si, Yin), so here it should be Si, and the same verse quoted in the note of the Yi Mao's chapter on the stars reads 'the third month follows the snake', which is Si, so the translation writes 'the dragon or snake' and this is explained here. 'The Robbery Killing rises the same as the Heavenly Prison killing' is translated literally and not expanded; the verse 'Heavenly Punishment, the ghost in prison' is short of a character (it should be 'Heavenly Punishment and Heavenly Prison, the ghost in prison'), and is translated as the broken line stands, 'wounded by cutting one's own throat' translating 'zi wen shang'. 'Ze si' is dying by being flogged (beaten with the rod). It is on the same path as the Yi Yin's 'a ghost carrying Heavenly Punishment, Heavenly Prison and Earthly Prison is a jail ghost', 'a ghost with the Chopping Block, Goat Blade and Robbery is a throat-cutting ghost' and 'a ghost carrying Huagai and the Lone Spirit is a ghost of monks and Daoists with no heir' (LY.ILL.YY.29), and the Yi Mao's 'Heavenly Prison is a ghost of flogging, beating, penal servitude and exile' and 'Huagai is monks and Daoists, Xianchi is courtesans' (LY.ILL.YM.62). The book does not say whether the 'first month' and so on are the months of the divination or of something else, and here it is copied as written; 'only these four positions, cycling round and round' means that the fifth month returns to the position of the first and the ninth to that of the first, and so on. Names of gods, spirits and stars in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; they are cults and stars of the Wu region that the book does not explain, and none is identified here beyond what the book says.

units.chapter: 搜决神鬼章第七十四·附总论之四:星煞值鬼诀
units.chapter_en: Chapter 74, appended general discourse 4: ghosts by the stars and killings
units.title: 星煞值鬼诀结语：此是玄机真妙诀、千金不换不可乱传；古时正统各处相同、今时邪祟各按本方；此章系苕城新著，别郡神司不同，吴下人可依此断，在他方问卜须另行细查

rule.yi: 这套用星煞认鬼神的办法，是玄机里真正妙的诀窍，千金也不换，不要乱传。古时候正的（正统的）大概全天下都一样，现在的邪祟却各按本地不同；这一章是苕城新写的，别的郡的神司不同，凡是吴下的人，可以照这个来断，如果在别的地方问卜，还应该另外详细查。
rule.en: This way of recognising ghosts and spirits by the stars and killings is the truly marvellous secret of the mysterious mechanism, not to be traded for a thousand pieces of gold, and not to be spread about. In antiquity the orthodox ones were, on the whole, the same all under heaven, but now evil hauntings each follow their own locality; this chapter was newly written at Tiaocheng, and the gods and offices of other prefectures differ, so that for all people of Wu one may judge by this, and if divining in another place, one should look into it separately in detail.

yi: 这是玄机里真正的妙诀，
千金也不换，不要乱传播。
en: This is the true marvellous secret of the mysterious mechanism,
not to be traded for a thousand pieces of gold; do not spread it about.

yi: 古时候正的大概全天下相同，
现在的邪祟各按本地不同；
这一章是苕城新写的，
别的郡的神司不同，
凡是吴下的人，
可以照这个来断；
如果在别的地方问卜，
还应该另外详细查。
en: In antiquity the orthodox ones were, on the whole, the same all under heaven;
nowadays evil hauntings each follow their own locality;
this chapter was newly written at Tiaocheng;
the gods and offices of other prefectures differ;
for all people of Wu,
one may judge by this;
if divining in another place,
one should look into it separately in detail.

note.yi: 这是整个「搜决神鬼」一章和它的四段「总论」的适用范围声明：这套神名和星煞，书里自己说是苕城新著、只适用吴下（别的郡的神司不同，别的地方问卜要另外详查）。所以把它们当作通用规则用，是超出了书自己划定的范围。「古之正人盖同天下」的「正人」文字含混，很可能是「正神」（和下句「邪祟」相对），这里按「正统的」译；「苕城」按字面译作 Tiaocheng（苕溪一带的城）。「玄机真妙诀，千金不换乱传扬」是歌诀的结尾，收的是本节的星煞诀。 这一段里神、鬼、星煞的名字，是吴地的民间神祇和星煞，书里没有解释，这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: This is the book's statement of the scope of the whole 'searching out ghosts and spirits' chapter and its four sections of 'general discourse': the book says itself that these names of gods and these stars and killings are newly written at Tiaocheng and apply only to Wu (the gods and offices of other prefectures differ, and in other places one must look into it separately in detail). To use them as general rules therefore goes beyond the scope the book itself draws. The 'zheng ren' in 'the orthodox ones of old' is loose in wording and is most likely 'zheng shen' (orthodox gods, against the 'evil hauntings' of the next line), and is translated as 'the orthodox ones'; 'Tiaocheng' is rendered literally as the town on the Tiao River. 'The true marvellous secret of the mysterious mechanism, not to be traded for a thousand pieces of gold' is the verse that closes, and it closes this section of the stars and killings. Names of gods, spirits and stars in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; they are cults and stars of the Wu region that the book does not explain, and none is identified here beyond what the book says.
